Branching strategies

Source: R/strategies-branch.R
branch-strategies.Rd

Combinators for branching rules after sympy.strategies.branch. A branching rule maps an expression to a list of results (SymPy's generators). branch_identity() returns its input, branch_exhaust() applies a rule until it has no effect, onaction() calls a function on each result that differs from the input and branch_debug() prints the rule, input and output of each, multiplex() merges the distinct results of several rules, branch_condition() applies a rule when a predicate holds, sfilter() keeps the results that satisfy a predicate, notempty() returns the input when a rule gives nothing, branch_do_one() uses the first rule that gives results, branch_chain() composes rules and yieldify() turns a rule into a branching rule. branch_top_down() applies a rule down an expression tree, branch_sall() applies it to the arguments, and branch_canon() applies rules top down until nothing changes.

Usage

branch_identity(x)

branch_exhaust(brule)

onaction(brule, fn)

branch_debug(brule, file = NULL)

multiplex(...)

branch_condition(cond, brule)

sfilter(pred, brule)

notempty(brule)

branch_do_one(...)

branch_chain(...)

yieldify(rl)

branch_canon(...)

branch_top_down(brule, fns = basic_fns)

branch_sall(brule, fns = basic_fns)

Arguments

x

An expression.

brule, ...

Branching rules.

fn

A function fn(brule, expr, result).

file

NULL to print to the console, or a connection to write to.

cond, pred

A predicate.

rl

A rule.

fns

Traversal functions (op, new, children, leaf), as basic_fns.

Value

A branching rule; branch_identity() returns a list.

Examples

posdec <- function(x) if (x > 0) list(x - 1L) else list(x)
branch5 <- function(x) {
  if (0 < x && x < 5) list(x - 1L) else if (5 < x && x < 10) list(x + 1L)
  else if (x == 5) list(x + 1L, x - 1L) else list(x)
}
branch_exhaust(branch5)(5L)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 0
#> 
multiplex(posdec, branch5)(5L)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 6
#> 
branch_chain(branch5, yieldify(function(x) x * 2L))(5L)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] 12
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] 8
#> 
x <- Symbol("x")
inc <- function(e) if (is_sym(e) && e$type == "Integer") list(e + 1L) else list()
branch_top_down(inc)(x + 1)
#> [[1]]
#> x + 2
#>
